entry.why: The packet establishes an elderly adult TRD population and a randomized, double-blind, parallel trial of intranasal esketamine plus oral antidepressant against matching intranasal placebo plus oral antidepressant. The age restriction narrows applicability but does not violate the question's adult population.

DESIGN: allocation RANDOMIZED | model PARALLEL | masking DOUBLE | who masked PARTICIPANT, INVESTIGATOR

ARM: Intranasal Esketamine plus Oral Antidepressant [EXPERIMENTAL] Participants will self-administer esketamine intranasally twice per week for 4 weeks as a flexible dose regimen in the Double-Blind Induction Phase.

ARM: Placebo plus Oral Antidepressant [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Participants will self-administer matching placebo, intranasally, twice per week for 4 weeks as a flexible dose regimen in Double-Blind Induction Phase using the same titration as Esketamine.

missed: No finding overturns either verdict. The packet explicitly establishes the parallel randomized design, contrary to the served row's UNKNOWN/DESIGN_UNPROVEN metadata, and reports an adjusted MMRM estimate with a 95% CI, as quoted above. Neither changes the specifically served raw MD. The registry describes the denominators as endpoint-evaluable participants within the FAS; 'observed cases at Day 28' is an interpretation rather than a verbatim population label.
